post.summary: Places a bid. Lower than the minimum next bid, after the deadline or on your own lot is 422.
post.description: Places a bid of at least `minNextBidCents`. Concurrent bids are serialised by optimistic locking on the auction row and the deadline is checked against the database clock; a bid that keeps losing the race (after `BID_MAX_RETRIES` attempts) is 409 `BID_CONFLICT` and can be retried. Too low, after the deadline, or on the caller’s own lot is 422. Rate limited per user. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID). A retry with the same key and body returns the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is 422.

post.summary: Turns the cart into one order with a seller order per seller.
post.description: Turns the cart into one order with one seller order per store, in a single database transaction: stock of every store is decremented with conditional updates, commission is computed per seller order and the ledger is written. Any unavailable line fails the whole checkout with 409 and nothing changes. With `expectedTotalCents` (the total the buyer saw) a cart whose prices moved meanwhile is refused with 409 `CHECKOUT_TOTAL_CHANGED` instead of being charged. Payment is a mock and runs asynchronously. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID). A retry with the same key and body returns the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is 422.

info.title: Marketplace API
info.description: Multi-vendor marketplace with real-time inventory. Every error response uses the `ErrorResponseDto` shape and carries the request correlation id.

password.description: At least one letter and one digit.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

details.description: Extra context; for VALIDATION_FAILED a list of `{ field, messages }` entries.

messages: priceCents must be an integer number

correlationId.description: Echo of the `X-Request-Id` response header; quote it when reporting a problem.

google.description: Whether the "Sign in with Google" button should be shown.

currentPassword.description: Required when the account already has a password.

hasPassword.description: Whether email and password sign-in works. False for an account created through Google, or one whose password was cleared when Google was linked; `POST /api/users/me/password` sets one.

slug.description: Unique, lower-case words joined by hyphens.

parentId.description: The new parent; `null` makes the category a root.

auctionId.description: The auction of an AUCTION product, set when the lot is created.

priceCents.description: Price in cents; required for FIXED_PRICE.

startPriceCents.description: Starting bid in cents; required for AUCTION.

bidStepCents.description: Minimum raise per bid in cents; required for AUCTION.

endsAt.description: When the first round ends, 1 minute to 30 days from now; required for AUCTION.

expectedStock.description: The stock the new value was decided on. When given and the stock has changed since (a sale, a cancellation), nothing is written and the answer is 409 PRODUCT_STOCK_CONFLICT with the current stock. Other edits of the product (a review, a new title) do not count.

priceCents.description: The leading bid, or the start price while nobody has bid.

open.description: True while the round still takes bids.

round.description: Starts at 1; a new round begins when the lot is offered again.

minNextBidCents.description: The lowest bid accepted now; null once the round is over.

winnerDeadlineAt.description: Until when the winner can check out.

version.description: Grows with every change; clients drop updates that are older.

serverTime.description: The server clock, to correct a client timer.

bidder.description: Masked for other people’s bids; the caller’s own say "You".

isOwn.description: True for the caller’s own bids.

amountCents.description: The bid in cents; at least `minNextBidCents`.

auction.description: The auction right after the bid.

auctionId.description: The lot to bid on; null for a fixed-price product.

auctionStatus.description: Where the lot stands; null for a fixed-price product.

auctionEndsAt.description: When bidding closes; null for a fixed-price product or after the lot's round.

min.description: Lowest price among all matches, in cents.

max.description: Highest price among all matches, in cents.

degraded.description: True when the SQL fallback answered, with fewer facets.

grossCents.description: Sales booked in the period, in kopecks.

refundsCents.description: Given back to buyers in the period: refunds and cancelled sales.

commissionCents.description: Platform commission in the period, net of reversals.

paidOutCents.description: Paid out to the store in the period.

balanceCents.description: Everything the platform owes the store now, over all time.

amountCents.description: Signed from the store’s point of view; positive is owed to it.

refId.description: The refund or payout it stems from.

expectedTotalCents.description: The total the buyer saw, in cents. When prices changed meanwhile the checkout is refused with 409 CHECKOUT_TOTAL_CHANGED instead of charging a different amount.

title.description: The title when the order was placed.

unitPriceCents.description: The price when the order was placed, in kopecks.

commissionRateBps.description: The commission rate this order was priced with, in basis points.

commissionCents.description: The platform commission on this seller order.
The platform commission on the whole order.

quantity.description: How many units to give back; at most what is left.

amountCents.description: Total refunded by this request, in kopecks.

sellerOrder.description: The seller order after the refund.

type.description: The event this notification reports, e.g. seller_order.created.

payload.description: Ids and new state from the event, plus the correlationId of the request behind it.

updated.description: How many notifications were marked read.

refundItems.description: Items to refund; only with RESOLVED_BUYER_FAVOR.

sellerOrderFinalStatus.description: The status the seller order ends in; only with RESOLVED_BUYER_FAVOR.

revenueCents.description: gross − refunds: what the ranking is by.
gross − refunds: what the ranking is by.

cartsWithItems.description: Carts that got their first item in the period.

convertedCarts.description: Of those, carts that became an order.

platformRevenueCents.description: Sum of commissions after refunds and cancellations.

deltaPct.description: Change from previous to current in percent; null when previous is zero.

current.description: One entry per day, oldest first.

previous.description: The same number of days right before.

schemaVersion.description: Changes when the shape of the report does.

timeZone.description: The zone that decides which day a sale is on.

daily.description: Every day of the period, oldest first.

products.description: Every product sold in the period, by revenue.

ordersCount.description: Orders not cancelled, placed in the period.

currentPriceCents.description: The leading bid, or the starting price while there are no bids.

ordersByStatus.description: Seller orders placed in the period, by their status now.

recentOrders.description: The five newest, whatever the period.

activeLots.description: Auctions taking bids now, ending first up front.
